paths: four-group current preference summary separates hard criteria, priorities, temporary choices and unknowns; correction opens its exact field without a mutation
revisit explains a known answer expiry, own explicit edit and public-pool change without resurrecting a withdrawn candidate identity or inferring attraction
busy closes only the old schedule; explicit reuse copies public place and duration to an unsent editable draft with blank dates and note; the new proposal has no inherited acceptance

one meeting reflection entry reveals only the explicitly selected topic; topic choice writes nothing and each save changes only its own record; extra topics stay optional and all private responses remain hidden from the other role
